visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: One Difference Is Not Squared
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The points (1, 2) and (4, 6) are 5 apart, so the squared distance is 25, but the program prints 5.

solution.explanation: The squared distance is dx squared plus dy squared. Leaving dy unsquared adds -4 instead of 16, so the total is 9 - 4 = 5 instead of 25.
